mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintainer (staff_no, name, gender, phone, department, duty, status, entry_date, remark) VALUES (#{staffNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{department}, #{duty}, #{status}, #{entryDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE maintainer SET staff_no = #{staffNo}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, department = #{department}, duty = #{duty}, status = #{status}, entry_date = #{entryDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM maintainer WHERE status = '在岗' ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintainer_plant (maintainer_id, pid, is_primary, status) VALUES (#{maintainerId}, #{pid}, #{isPrimary}, '有效') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary = VALUES(is_primary), status = '有效'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM maintainer_plant WHERE maintainer_id = #{maintainerId} AND pid = #{pid}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.pid, m.id, m.staff_no AS staffNo, m.name, m.gender, m.phone, m.department, m.duty, m.status FROM maintainer_plant mp INNER JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = mp.maintainer_id WHERE mp.status = '有效'

SELECT p.pid, m.id, m.staff_no AS staffNo, m.name, m.gender, m.phone, m.department, m.duty, m.status FROM plant p INNER JOIN plant_area a ON p.area_id = a.id INNER JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = a.maintainer_id WHERE a.maintainer_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintainer_plant (maintainer_id, pid, is_primary, status) SELECT #{maintainerId}, p.pid, 1, '有效' FROM plant p WHERE p.area_id = #{areaId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintainer_plant mp WHERE mp.pid = p.pid AND mp.status = '有效' AND mp.is_primary = 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = '有效'
